name: Warm plate
intro: Something warm, something cold, something sharp, on one plate. Lamb or leftover pork makes it dinner; the flavor makes it different each time.
time: 20 minutes if the squash is already roasted, 45 if not
yield: Dinner, plus a second plate or two lunches

proteins.name: Ground lamb
proteins.timing: Browned hard in a dry pan, 8–10 minutes. Half tonight, half keeps four days.

needs: Rice, about 1 cup cooked per plate — leftover is fine
Roasted kabocha, about ¼ squash per plate

steps.text: No roasted squash yet? Wedges, olive oil, salt, 425°F, 30–35 minutes. Start the rice.
Lamb: put it in a dry skillet over medium-high, press it flat, and leave it alone until it crusts underneath. Pork: warm the slices 2 minutes and skip to step 4.
Break the lamb up and cook until browned all over.
Add the garlic and chile flakes for the last minute. Salt it.
Build the plate in layers: rice, warm squash and protein, arugula on the side.

leftovers: Half the lamb keeps four days in the fridge. It's a second plate, toast for dinner, or the filling for a baked sweet potato.
